task: Swept the confidence threshold against the development set and diagnosed why it does nothing
produced: docs/decisions.md D13: threshold is inert across 0.50-0.998 (one flat line, then a cliff); classifier emits 2 distinct confidence values over 500 tickets; R-08's stated lever disproved and 20% over-answering identified as the real finding
ai_notes: Asked it to tune the threshold; it came back with a negative result instead and traced the cause to NB posterior saturation plus four-bin calibration. Kept the finding rather than patching the calibration, because recalibrating would invalidate both audits with six days left.
